topicName: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) & Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Technical Tutorial: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) & Testing Life Cycle (STLC) in Manual Testing"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Introduction to SDLC and STLC"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"The Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is a structured process used by software teams to design, develop, and test high-quality software. Concurrently, the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) dictates the execution phases dedicated specifically to quality assurance. Understanding how these two lifecycles intersect is fundamental for manual testers."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Phases of SDLC"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Requirement Analysis: Gathering business needs and specifications from stakeholders."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Planning: Estimating costs, resource allocation, and project scheduling."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Architectural Design: Defining system architecture, databases, and UI/UX layouts."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Software Development: Writing the actual code based on design specifications."},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Testing: Executing test cases to uncover defects before deployment."},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Deployment & Maintenance: Releasing the product to production and providing ongoing support."},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Phases of STLC in Manual Testing"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"While SDLC focuses on building the product, STLC focuses entirely on validating it. The manual testing process moves through six distinct phases."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Requirement Analysis: Testers analyze the Business Requirement Specification (BRS) document to identify testable features."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Test Planning: The Test Lead defines test strategy, resource planning, tool selection, and effort estimation."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Test Design & Development: Testers write detailed test scenarios, test cases, and prepare test data."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Test Environment Setup: Configuring a standalone environment mimicking production to run test cases accurately."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Test Execution: Manually executing test cases, logging defects, and comparing actual results with expected results."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Test Closure: Evaluating test completion criteria, preparing test metrics, and creating the Test Summary Report."},{"order":19,"type":"subheading","text":"4. Mapping SDLC to STLC"},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"Early integration of STLC within SDLC prevents costly defects. For instance, Requirement Analysis in STLC happens simultaneously with Requirement Analysis in SDLC. Test planning begins during the Design phase, allowing manual testers to build comprehensive test cases long before code deployment."},{"order":21,"type":"subheading","text":"5. Practical Example: Defect Lifecycle Management"},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"During manual test execution, finding a bug initiates the Defect Lifecycle. Below is a standard JSON payload representing a logged bug in an issue-tracking tool like Jira:"},{"order":23,"type":"code","text":"{
  "defect_id": "BUG-101",
  "module": "Authentication",
  "summary": "Login button unclickable on Safari browser",
  "severity": "High",
  "priority": "P1",
  "status": "New"
}"},{"order":24,"type":"subheading","text":"6. Conclusion"},{"order":25,"type":"paragraph","text":"Mastering both SDLC and STLC enables manual testers to align QA processes with overall business goals, ensuring high software reliability and seamless delivery."}]
